description_en: Play a video file during a voice call
description_zh: 在语音通话中插播视频文件
name: PlayVideoFile

parameters.description_en:
ID of the video file to play.

You can find approved video IDs on the [Video Files](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/slot) page.
parameters.description_zh:
视频插播文件ID。

您可以在[视频插播文件](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/slot)页面查看审核通过的视频ID。

parameters.description_en: Mobile phone number that receives the video playback.
parameters.description_zh: 接收视频播放的手机号码。
parameters.help_en: Mobile phone number that receives the video playback
parameters.help_zh: 接收视频播放的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.description_en:
Call ID. You can get the CallId from the response of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) operation.

> Use the CallId to call the [QueryVideoPlayProgress](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-queryvideoplayprogress?spm) operation and check the video playback progress.
parameters.description_zh:
通话一ID。您可以在[SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId。

> 您可以使用CallId，调用[QueryVideoPlayProgress](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-queryvideoplayprogress?spm)接口查看视频播放进度。
parameters.help_en:
Call ID. You can get the CallId from the response of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) operation.

> Use the CallId to call the [QueryVideoPlayProgress](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-queryvideoplayprogress?spm) operation and check the video playback progress
parameters.help_zh:
